Exception Scenario: One legacy engineering application requires temporary exemption from application allowlisting during vendor remediation
Compensating Controls: Defender monitoring; restricted user rights; network segmentation; application hash monitoring

Exception Scenario: Remote support session for a specialized manufacturing vendor requires a nonstandard maintenance window
Compensating Controls: Named account; MFA; approved source IP; session recording; ticket approval; automatic account expiration

Exception Scenario: Historic physical-access logs from one controlled area cannot be retroactively extended to the new retention period
Compensating Controls: Prospective standardized retention; visitor records; badge-management alerts; monthly access review
